headline: GREEN: no session planned, take an easy day. The plan needs a new race.
summary:
Readiness is GREEN. HRV is 77, up from 51 yesterday, so there's no drop to worry about. RHR is 47 and you slept 6.9h (score 84). CTL is 53.5 and ATL 47.2, so you're fresh at about +6.

The Valtellina block is over. Race day (7 Nov) was 22.1km / 825m D+ in 2h14 at an average of 172bpm, RPE 9. That's outside the sub-2h00 target. Since then you've logged 330 load in 8 days: 20 on the 9th, 30 on the 10th, 138 on the 11th (24.9km, 149bpm, feel 4 Poor) and 142 yesterday (Presolana, 19.6km / 1188m D+ in 2h45 at 143bpm, RPE 8, feel 1 Strong). Yesterday's average HR stayed in Z1 for a long climbing day, which is good control.

Nothing is planned from today on, and I'm not adding sessions until the next race is set. Today, after yesterday's 142: either 40-45min easy run at 130-150bpm on flat or rolling ground, or rest. If you have a bike, 45min Z2 spin at 134-147bpm is the no-impact option.
flags: The plan ends at the race (week 8, 2-8 Nov) and every date from 9 Nov has load 0. It needs repointing to a new race and block before I can prescribe again.
HRV was in the 40s on 4 of the last 6 days (48, 44, 48, 51) before today's 77. Sleep was 5.3h on 11 Nov and again on 15 Nov. Sleep is still the limiter, not load.
